reasons: Deviation classification is correct: the grant in p0030 runs to Licensee alone and p0041/p0045 limit use and access to Licensee's employees with no path other than Licensor's discretionary consent, so affiliates and contractors are excluded — below the fallback (affiliates on written notice), and p0149 gives no successor-transfer right.

The redline is directionally right and surgical on the operative terms: it inserts "its Affiliates and its contractors acting on Licensee's behalf" into the grant, carves the same parties out of the third-party disclosure and employees-only restrictions (with a confidentiality tether, which is a sensible concession), and adds an M&A successor-assignment exception to p0149. Deterministic anchors for affiliate coverage and no at-will revocation pass.

The 0.799 ratio flag on p0149 is an artefact of diff alignment; the substantive change is a single inserted exception clause, leaving the rest of the assignment provision intact, so the edit is minimal in substance.
Comment is accurate, in tone, cites the playbook position, and offers the fallback (affiliates on written notice).

Note for the negotiator (not a basis to reject): p0149 expressly defers any Change of Control to the Change Of Control section, so the inserted successor carve-out may not reach a merger/acquisition that triggers the auto-termination in p0134 — consider adding "notwithstanding the section entitled Change Of Control" or a parallel edit there. Also, "Affiliates" is capitalised but undefined in this agreement; a short definition should accompany the insert.
